These solar panel clips are constructed with a Zinc-Aluminum-Magnesium (Zn-Al-Mg) coating that offers enhanced corrosion resistance compared to traditional zinc coatings. These weather-resistant solar panel mounts are perfect for installations on farms, sheds, carports, boats, ground mounts, and rooftops.
